title: Ignite 2026: Entra adds CA policy plans, backup and agent IDs
summary: The Ignite Book of News lists a long Entra update. Generally available: Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise (agents and apps query Entra data through a permissions-based interface) and agentic traffic acquisition in Global Secure Access. In preview or announced as preview: Agent ID automatically assigned to discovered local agents (starting with GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code) and to Autopilot agents; Conditional Access policy plans (express access intent once, enforce consistently); high assurance credentials; Entra Backup and Recovery Premium with 30-day retention and Microsoft 365 Backup integration; cross-tenant configuration management; PIM and dynamic group additions (MemberOf, transitive 'reports to'); and Global Secure Access controls for local agents, an MCP Firewall and adaptive access.
why: Two themes matter for tenant admins. First, local coding agents are being given their own identities, which separates agent activity from the user in logs and policy. Second, several long-requested admin features (longer directory backup, cross-tenant configuration drift control, CA at scale) arrive as previews, so they are not yet something to design production around.
todo: Do now: if developers use GitHub Copilot CLI or Claude Code, decide who will own agent identities in Entra and how they fit your Conditional Access and access review model.
Evaluate Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise (GA) carefully: scope its permissions like any other app with directory read access.

Wait: CA policy plans, Backup and Recovery Premium, cross-tenant configuration management and the GSA agent controls are preview per Microsoft; treat them as announced and unverified until they appear in your tenant and Message Center.
effective_note: Mostly preview; MCP Server for Enterprise and agentic traffic acquisition GA — per Microsoft's Book of News.
